title: Application Architecture
content: Single-page scroll-driven architecture: index.vue orchestrates scroll state via useScrollTransition composable, which controls HeroSection (3D map), CloudOverlay (transition effect), and AboutSection (info panel). All components respond to scroll progress (0-1).

title: Scroll Transition System
content: useScrollTransition provides: scrollProgress (0-1 smoothed), isFrozen (>5%), zoomProgress (0-50% → 0-1), cloudProgress (15-70% → 0-1), aboutProgress (50-100% → 0-1). Uses RAF-based interpolation with 0.08 damping factor.

title: 3D Map System (useMap)
content: Modular Three.js composable with submodules: camera.ts (zoom/parallax), loader.ts (SVG→3D mesh), labels.ts (city labels), markers.ts (region markers), grid.ts (background grid), textures.ts (canvas textures), config.ts (constants), types.ts (interfaces). Scene contains: lights, fogGroup, gridGroup, combinedMapGroup (Uzbekistan + neighbors), labelsGroup.

title: Component Hierarchy
content: index.vue (scroll-page 200vh) → fixed-layer (100vh): grain-overlay, vignette-overlay, HeroSection (frozen, zoomProgress, hidden props), CloudOverlay (progress, aboutProgress), AboutSection (progress, backgroundImage). HeroSection contains: loader, map-container, back-button, hints, header.

title: Map Animation Loop
content: Sequence: 1) tweenGroup.update(), 2) animateGrid(), 3) updateParallax(), 4) animateMarkers (!frozen,!zoomed), 5) updateMarkerScales (!frozen), 6) updateLabelPositions (!frozen), 7) updateLabelsProximity (!frozen,!zoomed), 8) Fog animation (!frozen,!zoomed), 9) renderer.render()
